verdict.rationale: Official docs explicitly describe elastic SIP trunking and importing numbers from Twilio, Telnyx, and Vonage, walking through setting up a SIP trunk and pointing/importing numbers into Retell — directly matching the story. This is first-party documentation without independent hands-on corroboration of the SIP flow itself. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of a real SIP trunk setup working end-to-end, and detail on carrier-specific edge cases (codecs, failover, latency).
